repo.ISSUE.md: label_tickets gives me the lookup, but `lines` is always empty. I expected one line per ticket.

fix.code:
def label_tickets(names, tickets):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> hours dict and one 'name: hours' line per ticket."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.hours for x in tickets)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
